errors.text: The cited evidence reports that replacing Co with Cr promotes B2+BCC decomposition, contradicting the hypothesis's single-phase condition and BCC-only structural mediator.
The cited evidence supports increased coercivity after Cr substitution but does not establish increased magnetic anisotropy as the causal mechanism.
The proposed experiment says to keep all other elements constant, whereas the cited intervention replaces Co with Cr; these are compositionally different interventions.
